en: {rival}
{player}! There you are! I heard Team Aqua was causing trouble at the Weather Institute. Did you sort it out?
You did? I knew it. I've been training nonstop since Lavaridge, so let's see whose team grew more!
{rival}
Beaten again! You really are something, {player}. I think Dad would want you to have this.
That's Fly. Teach it to a bird Pokémon and it'll carry you to any town you've been to before.
You'll need Fortree's Badge before you can use it outside battle, though. The Gym's just up the road!
I'm going to keep looking for Pokémon around here. See you, {player}!
Scott
{player}! I caught the end of that from up the path. You two pushed each other hard, didn't you?
And I hear Team Aqua was chased out of the Weather Institute too. You do get around!
Fortree's Leader, Winona, flies like no one else. I'd love to see how you fare against her. Good luck!
Team Aqua Grunt
Our admin's busy inside. The weather people have something we want, and we're not leaving without it.
Team Aqua Grunt
Rain, sun, storms... If we know how the weather works, we can make the sea grow. Now scram!
Jackson
You've got good instincts. Want to swap numbers? Rangers stick together.
Register Jackson in the PokéNav's Match Call?
Good. I'll check in after my patrol.
Understood. Stay safe out there.
Catherine
You're strong! Can we keep in touch? I want to know how you're getting on.
Register Catherine in the PokéNav's Match Call?
Thanks! I'll call when my Gloom grows.
Aww, okay. Good luck on the road!
